string_repeat.markdown:
Returns `str` repeated `count` times.
See also `string_length` and [a link](https://example.invalid/link).
Closer to `string_repeat` (GameMaker manual) than to `string_copy` (GameMaker manual).
See the GameMaker manual.  $[unknownMacro](x)
Non-sync: returns local state without network latency - useful for displaying information or previewing an action locally, but it differs between players, so it must not influence synchronised gameplay state.
```
var s = string_repeat("ab", 3); // "ababab"
```
